title: 机构特定LLM提示恢复去标识系统及其金标准遗漏的受保护健康信息
summary: 研究评估LLM结合上下文学习在电子健康记录去标识中的表现，发现LLM优于专用系统（F1=0.918 vs 0.779），通过机构特定提示恢复79%遗漏的PHI，并平衡精确率与召回率。
summary_en: LLMs with in-context learning outperform purpose-built de-identification systems (F1=0.918 vs 0.779), recovering 79% of institutionally situated PHI via specific prompts, and balancing precision-recall trade-off.
